analysis_notes: foxBMS project uses Axivion for static analysis with documented deviations
Most DIAG_Handler() calls use (void) cast for intentional return value ignore - COMPLIANT
while(true) loops in RTOS tasks have AXIVION deviation markers - DOCUMENTED DEVIATION
Pointer casts to void* for queue operations are FreeRTOS API requirements - DOCUMENTED DEVIATION

violations.rule_text: A conversion should not be performed from pointer to void into pointer to object
violations.message: Cast to void* for FreeRTOS xTaskCreateStatic API - FreeRTOS requires void* parameter type
violations.remediation_hint: Document deviation - required by FreeRTOS API design
violations.deviation_justification: FreeRTOS API requires void* parameter for task creation functions. This is a third-party library interface requirement.

documented_deviations.description: while(true) infinite loops in FreeRTOS tasks
documented_deviations.justification: FreeRTOS task design requires infinite loops for task execution. Tasks should never return. See www.freertos.org/a00125.html
documented_deviations.axivion_marker: AXIVION Next Codeline Style MisraC2012-2.2 FaultDetection-DeadBranches

documented_deviations.justification: TI CCS compiler requires #pragma TASK for proper task context handling. This is a compiler extension requirement.

documented_deviations.description: Unsigned integer subtraction for time difference calculation
documented_deviations.justification: Unsigned arithmetic underflow is intentionally used for timer wrap-around handling. Correctness is verified by unit tests.
